name: 料理の栄養表示と構成説明
prompt: Render ONE compact Japanese nutritional information UI component LH19-0055 on pure white canvas. Input1 ORIGINAL is highest priority for hierarchy, proportions, spacing and any fine detail (target source x48,y1082,w1083,h142); no icons occur in this text-only target, do not invent them. Input2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY for exact localized content and compact layout. Input3 comparison originalLEFT/mockRIGHT. Input4 official white/forest/slate design. Exact three left-aligned lines with natural vertical spacing: 1,130〜2,010 kcal ; 主菜1品、副菜2品、飲み物1杯を組み合わせます。 ; 数値は参照画面に由来する表示例です。 Preserve all punctuation, commas and Japanese. This is sample UI text, not nutritional advice. Meiryo first line Bold14/24 (small emphasis, not a headline), second line Regular14/24 normal400, third line Regular12/16. Tracking0. Main text#1D1D1D, secondary#6E6E6E. White background/panel, no colored fill, no badge/green action, no decorative symbols. Logical390px width,16px padding, compact totalheight120px similar mock, enlarged crisp raster output with modest white border. Apple-like readable hierarchy, no added heading or phone/ID/annotations. Do not import food photograph or surrounding app parts.
reviewNotes: Text-only原本とmockの全3行を保持、白とneutraltext、欠けなし。ただし先頭栄養値行が指定14px本文と同じcompact scaleより大きいheadline状に生成された。Meiryo exact faceは未認定。先頭のsize/weight階層の補正が必要。原本fine-detail優先、icons/photoは対象なし。所有者承認・native・実装は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
